clips.title: The story
paras: In the Hillsbrad Foothills, the Forsaken move against the humans resisting their advance. High Executor Darthalia orders the smithy in Hillsbrad Fields destroyed, hoping to cut off the weapons arming the local people.

The Forsaken meet fiercer resistance in the Hillsbrad Foothills than High Executor Darthalia expected. Rural humans refuse to scatter or yield to the Deathstalkers and soldiers sent from Tarren Mill. The Forsaken learn that the peasantry are not fighting with pitchforks and scythes alone. In the fields, they are being armed for war.

At the southwest edge of Hillsbrad Fields, Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices forge blades and armor for the militia from raw ore. Darthalia sends an operative to kill Verringtan, butcher his apprentices, and seize their stockpiled iron shipment. She aims to weaken the settlement's defense and use the metal in the eventual assault on Southshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance. The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith. We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan. Slay his apprentices as well. While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile. The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to carry out your orders, adventurer? Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants? And where is that iron shipment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mission accomplished, adventurer. And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
